description: This file implements a server component for Kubernetes cloud provider, managing controllers such as node, lifecycle, service, and route controllers, with functions to start each controller and process CIDRs.

methods.name: startCloudNodeController
methods.description: Starts the cloud node controller, returning the controller interface, a boolean indicating success, and an error if any.

methods.name: startCloudNodeLifecycleController
methods.description: Starts the cloud node lifecycle controller, returning the controller interface, a boolean indicating success, and an error if any.

methods.name: startServiceController
methods.description: Starts the service controller, returning the controller interface, a boolean indicating success, and an error if any.

methods.name: startRouteController
methods.description: Starts the route controller if cloud routes are configured and supported, returning the controller interface, a success boolean, and an error if any.

methods.name: processCIDRs
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of CIDRs, returning a list of IPNet objects, a boolean indicating dual-stack configuration, and an error if parsing fails.
